APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE TEK PORCELANI!
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e tete banim te nje prej komplekseve me te reja dhe cilesore te zones se Porcelanit, Ne Rrugen Xhanfize keko.
Kompleksi pritet te perfundoje deri ne mes te vitit 2026
Kompleksi do ofroje te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode si: farmaci, furre buke, restorant, bar, supermarket, palester, pishine luksoze, park lojerash per femije etj.
Ka nje siperfaqe totale 105.66 M2 dhe siperfaqe neto 88.11 M2.

Nje sallon se bashku me kuzhinen e gatimit

description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT PORCELANI! The apartment is located on the eighth residential floor of one of the newest and quality complexes in the Porcelani area, on Xhanfize Keko Street. The complex is expected to be completed by the middle of 2026. The complex will offer all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life such as: pharmacy, bakery, restaurant, bar, supermarket, gym, luxury swimming pool, playground for children, etc. It has a total area of ​​105.66 M2 and a net area of ​​88.11 M2. It is organized in: A living room together with a kitchen, two bedrooms, a toilet, a balcony
